requirements.verbatim: fund your Bask Mileage Savings Account with at least $50,000 within 15 days of account opening
maintain that balance for 90 consecutive days out of the first 120 days following the initial account opening

notes: Bonus is 20,000 American Airlines miles, not a cash bonus, so bonus_total is null. Account also earns 1.75 AA miles per $1 annually (not a cash APY - 0% interest). Miles valued at $0.42/point for 1099 tax reporting purposes per article. Hold requirement is 90 consecutive days within a 120-day window after the 15-day funding deadline (not a fixed hold_days from opening).
